title: Adobe Firefly Generation Request and Response
description: Schema for Adobe Firefly generative AI image generation requests and their asynchronous responses. Covers text-to-image generation, generative fill, generative expand, and similar image generation workflows. Includes request parameters such as prompt, style, and size, as well as response structures containing job identifiers and generated output image references.

ImageSize.description: Dimensions for a generated output image

StyleOptions.description: Style guidance options for the Firefly generation model

presets.description: List of style preset identifiers to apply to the generation

items.description: A named style preset that influences the aesthetic of the output

strength.description: Strength of style influence on the generated output, from 1 (subtle) to 100 (strong)

OutputImage.description: A single generated image output from a Firefly generation job

image.description: Reference to the generated image file

url.description: Temporary pre-signed URL to download the generated image. URLs expire after a short period.

seed.description: The seed value used to produce this specific output variation. Reusing the same seed with the same prompt and parameters produces the same output.

contentClass.description: The content class applied or detected for this output

oneOf.title: Firefly Generation Request
oneOf.description: Request body for submitting a Firefly image generation job

prompt.description: Natural language text description of the image to generate. Clear, descriptive prompts produce better results.
examples: A serene mountain lake at golden hour with reflections of pine trees

negativePrompt.description: Text description of visual elements or qualities to avoid in the generated image

contentClass.description: Broad content category that guides the generation model toward a photographic or artistic style

numVariations.description: Number of distinct image variations to generate in a single request

seeds.description: Array of integer seed values for reproducible generation. Each seed corresponds to one variation. Providing the same seed and prompt produces the same output.

items.description: Integer seed value for a single generation variation

locale.description: BCP 47 language locale to assist with multilingual prompt interpretation

oneOf.title: Firefly Generation Response
oneOf.description: Response body containing the status and outputs of a Firefly generation job

jobId.description: Unique identifier assigned to this generation job upon submission

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the generation job

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the generation job was submitted

modified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the generation job was last updated

outputs.description: Array of generated image outputs produced by a successful job. Empty or absent if the job has not yet succeeded.

errors.description: List of errors encountered if the generation job failed

examples.prompt: A serene mountain lake at golden hour with reflections of pine trees
